name: Foundr

sources.title: Homepage — global entrepreneur media/education company (magazine, podcast, courses; claims 3M+ audience)
Get Featured — application for editorial interview features across magazine, podcast, blog, and social

conditions: Free editorial application, but acceptance is highly selective — '40-50+ pitches per day' and 'we cannot respond to every request'
Only real practitioners: founders who have actually built a business; 'practitioners not gurus'
Preference for innovative/market-leading companies — often top-3 brands in their niche with products that 'impacted millions'
requirements: Apply via the form behind the 'Apply Now' buttons on /get-featured
Must be a founder with a real operating business and a story worth an interview
Interview format: ~30-45 min Skype audio call or in-person video
Selected interviews produce a magazine spread, podcast episode, blog post, and social features
preparation: A founder story with concrete traction — revenue, impact, lessons learned
Willigness to do a recorded interview
Pitch that emphasizes actionable lessons for other founders, not product promotion
workflow: Click 'Apply Now' and complete the application form
If selected, the team reaches out and schedules a 30-45 min interview
Interview is repurposed into magazine spread, podcast, blog post, and social posts
watchFor: This is earned media, not a directory listing — most applicants never get a reply
Not to be confused with foundr.ai (a separate AI-tools directory)
Products 'should have impacted millions' — early-stage SaaS without traction is unlikely to qualify
No self-serve listing exists anywhere on the site
countsAsLive: A published Foundr magazine/podcast/blog feature about the founder/company appears on foundr.com
unknowns: Current acceptance criteria weighting and response time
Whether payment is ever involved for features (page presents it as editorial)
